summary: The Gaming Investor shares his investment philosophy focused on finding undervalued, under-analyzed gaming companies with potential for 5x returns. He discusses his successful case with Frontier Developments, current holdings in Endor (simracing equipment) and Remedy, and his private investments in companies like Quixel (acquired by Epic) and Polygonflow. He emphasizes the importance of understanding the business model, looking at cash flow, and being able to become one of the top experts on a company.
key_takeaways: Looks for undervalued, under-analyzed companies with potential for 5x returns
Prefers companies with honest management and minimal downside risk
Focuses on understanding cash flow rather than just P/E ratios
Values companies with simple, understandable business models like Endor's single product line
Has shifted more toward private/unlisted investments where he can work directly with founders
